description: AlphaFold model of N. crassa RTT109: pLDDT at mapped determinants and predicted active-site geometry
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q7S1R7",timeout=90).json()[0]
print({k:meta[k] for k in meta if k in ("modelEntityId","globalMetricValue","latestVersion","pdbUrl","cifUrl","paeImageUrl")})
txt=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
atoms=[]
for l in txt.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                          x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms); ca=A[A.name=="CA"].set_index("resi")
print("residues modelled:",len(ca),"| mean pLDDT:",round(ca.b.mean(),1))
t2o=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',LEU='L',
         LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V')
nc_map={"D89":145,"A88":144,"F192":190,"R194":192,"Y199":197,"H211":215,"W221":225,"W222":226,
        "D287":304,"D288":305,"K290":307,"R292":309,"L148":173,"I150":175,"L151":176,
        "R355":463,"K356":464,"E374":488,"E378":492,"F380":494,"N382":496,
        "K425":613,"A430":618,"T436":628}
cls={**{k:"catalytic/autoAc" for k in ["D89","R194","Y199","W222","D287","D288","K290"]},
     **{k:"cofactor" for k in ["A88","F192","H211","W221"]},
     **{k:"Vps75-equivalent" for k in ["L148","I150","L151","R355","K356","E374","E378","F380","N382"]},
     **{k:"Asf1-equivalent" for k in ["R292","K425","A430","T436"]}}
rows=[dict(yeast=y,ncrassa=f"{t2o[ca.loc[n,'res']]}{n}",pLDDT=round(ca.loc[n,'b'],1),group=cls[y]) for y,n in nc_map.items()]
res=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["group","ncrassa"])
pd.set_option("display.width",200)
print("\n=== pLDDT at N. crassa residues equivalent to yeast Rtt109 determinants ===")
print(res.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmean pLDDT by group:\n", res.groupby("group").pLDDT.agg(['mean','min','max']).round(1).to_string())

tip={"ASP":"CG","GLU":"CD","LYS":"NZ","ARG":"CZ","TRP":"CZ2","TYR":"OH","HIS":"NE2","PHE":"CZ"}
def tipxyz(resi):
    sub=A[A.resi==resi]; rn=sub.res.iloc[0]; t=tip.get(rn,"CA")
    s2=sub[sub.name==t]
    if s2.empty: s2=sub[sub.name=="CA"]
    return s2[["x","y","z"]].values[0], rn
core=[144,145,190,192,197,215,225,226,304,305,307]
lab=[];XY=[]
for r in core:
    v,rn=tipxyz(r); XY.append(v); lab.append(f"{t2o[rn]}{r}")
XY=np.array(XY); D=np.linalg.norm(XY[:,None,:]-XY[None,:,:],axis=-1)
print("\n=== side-chain-tip distances (Angstrom), predicted active site ===")
print(pd.DataFrame(np.round(D,1),index=lab,columns=lab).to_string())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5))
ax=axes[0]; ax.plot(ca.index,ca.b,lw=0.8,color="#555555")
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",color="#b2182b",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(90,ls=":",color="#1b7837",lw=0.8)
colm={"catalytic/autoAc":"#b2182b","cofactor":"#762a83","Vps75-equivalent":"#e08214","Asf1-equivalent":"#2166ac"}
seen=set()
for y,n in nc_map.items():
    g=cls[y]; ax.plot(n,ca.loc[n,"b"],"o",ms=6,color=colm[g],label=g if g not in seen else None); seen.add(g)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_xlabel("residue position in Q7S1R7"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence along N. crassa RTT109 (NCU09825)\nmean pLDDT 69.1; dashed line 70",fontsize=10)
im=axes[1].imshow(D,cmap="viridis_r")
axes[1].set_xticks(range(len(lab))); axes[1].set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_yticks(range(len(lab))); axes[1].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(lab)):
    for j in range(len(lab)): axes[1].text(j,i,f"{D[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,color="white" if D[i,j]>16 else "black")
axes[1].set_title("Side-chain tip distances in the predicted\ncatalytic pocket (Angstrom)",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=axes[1],fraction=0.046)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nmean pLDDT, catalytic core 140-320:",round(ca.loc[140:320,'b'].mean(),1))
print("mean pLDDT, region aligned to yeast Vps75 interface (Nc 455-500):",round(ca.loc[455:500,'b'].mean(),1))
print("mean pLDDT, C-terminal 600-630:",round(ca.loc[600:630,'b'].mean(),1))
print("mean pLDDT, N-terminal 1-40:",round(ca.loc[1:40,'b'].mean(),1))
